title: DUEL: Exact Likelihood Reshapes Masked Diffusion Scaling Laws and Beyond
abstract: arXiv:2603.01367v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Masked diffusion models (MDMs) are trained to predict tokens in every order but generate in one. As such, MDM likelihood is an intractable sum over all orders. The evidence lower bound (ELBO) is used as a proxy for likelihood, but it is a loose bound and assumes positions are unmasked uniformly at random. Frontier MDMs, however, select positions with deterministic rules such as confidence. To resolve this mismatch we introduce DUEL, a framework that unifies common deterministic MDM samplers. DUEL computes the likelihood exactly, under the sampler that is actually used during generation. DUEL is a simple plug-and-play algorithm applicable to any pretrained MDM with no retraining. To compute the likelihood of a text sequence, simply replay generation, reveal the true tokens instead of sampled ones, and sum their log-probabilities. translated_title: DUEL：精确似然重塑掩码扩散模型的缩放定律及更多发现
translated_abstract: 掩码扩散模型（MDMs）被训练为以任意顺序预测词元，但在生成时只以一种顺序进行。因此，MDM的似然是对所有顺序求和的难解计算。证据下界（ELBO）被用作似然的代理，但它是一个宽松的界，并且假设位置是均匀随机掩码的。然而，前沿的MDM使用确定性规则（如置信度）来选择位置。为解决这种不匹配，我们引入了DUEL，这是一个统一常见确定性MDM采样器的框架。DUEL可以在生成时实际使用的采样器下精确计算似然。DUEL是一种简单的即插即用算法，适用于任何预训练的MDM，无需重新训练。要计算文本序列的似然，只需重放生成过程，用真实词元替代采样词元，并对它们的对数概率求和。使用DUEL而非ELBO进行评估，改变了我们关于MDM的结论。（注：原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文提出DUEL框架，能够在掩码扩散模型实际使用的确定性采样器下精确计算其似然，无需重新训练即可即插即用，并由此重塑了关于掩码扩散模型缩放定律等一系列结论。
en_tdlr: DUEL is a plug-and-play framework that computes the exact likelihood of masked diffusion models under the deterministic samplers actually used during generation, requiring no retraining, and thereby reshapes conclusions such as MDM scaling laws.
